name: Music SDK Test (dev)
author: Hails
description: Dev only (doc 11 Music banks, sdk.music): plays its own bank (make it first: py -3.13 make_bank.py <skate3rust.exe> [--from <music folder> --count N]; default three self-made tones) through a mixed playlist, restyles the caption, sets the volume, skips, queues, stops and hands back to the soundtrack, logging one MUSIC_TEST line per check. Disabling it gives the music back to the engine.

first_title.label: First track
first_title.description: Title of the playlist's first track (make_bank.py prints it).

second_title.label: Second track
second_title.description: Title of the playlist's second track.

step_seconds.label: Listen per step (s)
step_seconds.description: Seconds each track plays before the next check (raise it to listen).
